objective: Photocatalysis-grade TpPa-1 synthesis with documented route decision and two quantified process optimizations

retro_backend.production_path: GOAI_RETRO_PROVIDER=http (ASKCOS/RXN) + cross-validation against the literature route

steps.name: Monomer sourcing & purification
steps.conditions: Tp: purchase or Duff-type formylation of phloroglucinol per origin literature prep; Pa-1: sublime/recrystallize immediately before use, store cold/dark under N2
steps.reasoning: Monomer solubility/purity enables error-correcting growth under mild conditions [peng2016room]; Pa-1 air-oxidation is a chemical-practice inference (labeled as such)
steps.characterization: 1H NMR purity check of Tp; melting point + color check of sublimed Pa-1
steps.safety: p-phenylenediamine: toxic, skin sensitizer, suspected mutagen — nitrile gloves, goggles, fume hood, no dust; sealed N2 storage. In-house Tp prep (Duff-type formylation): concentrated-acid handling and thermal decomposition risk of hexamethylenetetramine — face shield, fume hood, controlled quench

steps.name: Schiff-base polycondensation (baseline R1 solvothermal)
steps.conditions: Sealed tube, 120 C, 72 h; degassed solvent; slow cooling (origin protocol; abstract confirms solvent system and Schiff-base chemistry)
steps.reasoning: Reversible imine equilibrium enables error correction (crystallinity); moderate solvation suppresses excessive reversibility and grows crystallites [xu2026structural]; irreversible enol->keto tautomerization locks the framework (only keto observed) [kandambeth2012construction]
steps.characterization: Color change monitoring (dark red precipitate); reaction completion by monomer disappearance
steps.safety: 1,4-dioxane: suspected carcinogen + peroxide former (peroxide test, never to dryness); mesitylene flammable; AcOH corrosive; autogenous pressure at 120 C — rated ampoule/autoclave + blast shield + slow cooling

steps.name: Work-up & activation
steps.conditions: Wash with anhydrous acetone/DMAc-type solvents; solvent-exchange to low-boiling solvent; vacuum dry (work-up level per origin & terracotta protocols)
steps.reasoning: Remove oligomers/residual monomer; for the R3 variant, p-TsOH must be fully water-washed before activation
steps.characterization: PXRD (vs simulated eclipsed pattern), FT-IR + 13C CP-MAS NMR (keto signature), N2 sorption BET, TGA, SEM/TEM
steps.safety: Standard organic-solvent handling in fume hood; segregate amine-containing waste as hazardous

steps.name: Photocatalytic HER deployment (context step)
steps.conditions: In-situ Pt photodeposition, visible-light sacrificial HER per TpPa-COF-X benchmark setup
steps.reasoning: Pt speciation (NP -> cluster -> single atom) is a separately tunable factor; deployment protocol anchors the quality targets of steps 0-2
steps.characterization: GC-based H2 quantification; AQY at specified wavelength; post-run PXRD/BET stability check
steps.safety: H2/O2 mixtures explosive: gas-tight degassed reactor, inert headspace, ventilated GC sampling; H2PtCl6 corrosive/sensitizer

optimizations.name: Microwave-assisted synthesis
optimizations.quantified_gain: BET 152 -> 725 m2/g (~4.8x) for TpPa-1 in the direct comparison; time -98.6%
optimizations.caveat: For transimination-based quality upgrading, solvothermal outperformed microwave for beta-ketoenamine COFs [grenu2020microwave]
optimizations.safety: Microwave-rated sealed reactors with T/p monitoring and pressure relief only

optimizations.name: Green-solvent continuous flow
optimizations.delta_conditions: Batch -> continuous flow in diacetin (CHEM21 + Hansen + dG_solv selected)
optimizations.quantified_gain: BET 418 m2/g; 30x space-time-yield; -89% specific energy vs batch; +50% CO2 uptake at 298 K vs batch (diacetin); prior art flow STY 703 kg m-3 day-1 (COF-LZU1) and RT batch TpPa-1 comparable to solvothermal
optimizations.safety: Flow reactor pressure-drop monitoring; diacetin low-hazard per CHEM21 ranking [xu2026structural]

optimizations.name: p-TsOH salt-mediated rapid crystallization
optimizations.delta_conditions: Seconds-scale crystallization; twin-screw extruder continuous processing
optimizations.quantified_gain: Family surface areas up to 3000 m2/g; seconds vs days
optimizations.caveat: TpPa-1-specific in-library numbers thinner than O1/O2; salt removal work-up
optimizations.safety: p-TsOH corrosive; full aqueous removal before activation

literature_supported: Reversible imine + irreversible enol->keto tautomerization; keto is the observed thermodynamic sink [kandambeth2012construction]
Product stability 9 N HCl / boiling water [kandambeth2012construction; biswal2013mechanochemical]
